rawPaths.label: Show raw paths
rawPaths.hint: Full paths instead of the ~ and %LOCALAPPDATA% shorthands. The delete dialog always shows full paths.

refresh.label: Refresh
refresh.manualHint: Scans when the app starts and when you press Refresh (F5).
refresh.watchHint: Rescans as soon as Claude or Codex writes something new.

data.hint: Found on every scan. The app only changes files of a session you act on.
data.hint_codex: Found on every scan. The app only reads it; the Codex CLI archives and deletes.
data.cliHint: Used to archive, restore and delete.

roots.label: All folders
roots.noDesktop: No Claude Desktop claude-code-sessions folder found
roots.codexCliMissing: Not found: install it with "npm i -g @openai/codex"

cache.label: Scan cache
cache.hint: Makes rescans faster. Clearing it never touches Claude or Codex data.

debug.label: Debug mode
debug.hint: Detailed log, the session JSON in the details panel, and DevTools (F12).

logs.label: App folders and log
logs.hint: For troubleshooting. Only shown here, never sent anywhere.

advanced.summary: Paths, scan cache, debug mode and logs

storeEdition.limits: Microsoft Store edition: sessions that have Claude Desktop metadata are view- and export-only. Archive, Restore and Delete are unavailable for them because Windows Store packaging isolates certain AppData writes. Transcript-only sessions can be hidden or deleted as usual.
